supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong at 13:44:07 UTC, with nora.blake as the subject.
The creation subject logon ID matches a network logon by nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 shortly before the account was created.
Immediately after creation, ext.rwong was added to the Freelancers group. The ext.<name> naming pattern and Freelancers-only assignment match the documented help-desk temporary-account practice.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the account creation and one group addition, but do not provide a complete audit of all group memberships or later account changes.
The supplied evidence does not include an account request or approval record.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested or approved through the organization's normal process.
Whether ext.rwong later received additional group memberships or privileges, or was used to access resources.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe launched under nora.blake on WS-NBLAKE-01 and loaded a validly signed Cisco library. The inventory says there is no VPN; these records show a launch, not a VPN connection. Review separately and do not use this to determine the account-creation alert. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
